description: This file defines the EmployeeBenefitApplication class and related functions for managing employee benefit applications within the ERPNext payroll system, including validation, benefit calculations, and data retrieval.

classes.name: EmployeeBenefitApplication
classes.description: Represents an employee benefit application document with validation and benefit calculation methods.

methods.name: validate
methods.description: Performs validation checks on the benefit application, including active employee validation, duplicate checks, and benefit limits.

methods.name: validate_prev_benefit_claim
methods.description: Validates previous benefit claims against the current application.

methods.name: validate_remaining_benefit_amount
methods.description: Validates the remaining benefit amount against salary structure components.

methods.name: validate_max_benefit_for_component
methods.description: Ensures total benefit amount does not exceed maximum allowed benefits.

methods.name: validate_max_benefit
methods.description: Checks if a specific earning component's benefit exceeds its maximum.

methods.name: validate_duplicate_on_payroll_period
methods.description: Prevents duplicate applications for the same employee and payroll period.
